description: An incident involving unauthorized privileged access by user 'root' has been detected. Legal and compliance teams require both forensic evidence and ongoing audit reporting. Your tasks are: (1) use EventLog Analyzer's Log Search to find all events associated with the user 'root' from the last 24 hours, then use the export functionality to save the search results as a CSV file to ~/Desktop/root_activity_export.csv, (2) navigate to Settings and configure a log archival policy named 'Legal Evidence Hold' — set the archive retention period to at minimum 730 days (2 years) to preserve evidence for legal proceedings, (3) go to the Reports section and create a new scheduled report named 'Daily SOC Security Summary' configured to run every day, covering all available log sources, and (4) create an alert profile named 'Root Access Monitor' with Critical severity triggered by any root authentication events (threshold: 1 event). Log in with username: admin, password: admin.
